description: Shared tool registry for the content stack. One entry per remote tool source (MCP, OpenAPI, or plain HTTP) so the Content Bot, the Smart Router, and n8n call the same endpoints with the same capabilities. Values may use ${ENV_NAME} placeholders; the loader substitutes them from the process environment and never stores credentials here. Deployments edit data/content-manager/config/tools.json; the shipped copy is only the default.

tools.title: Media Studio
tools.notes: Job queue for AI images, Flow videos, and operator-clip edits; POST /uploads stores a raw clip for the video-edit driver.

tools.title: n8n MCP tools
tools.notes: MCP Server Trigger workflow managed by scripts/bootstrap-n8n.mjs (n8n path /mcp/hermes). The bearer token is N8N_TRIGGER_MCP_TOKEN in the Hermes environment file; today Hermes Agent is the MCP client (N8N_MCP_MODE=trigger).

tools.title: Smart Router
tools.notes: OpenAI-compatible gateway; the router also serves GET /v1/tools with the entries it may call.

tools.title: Web search
tools.notes: Keyless HTML endpoint used by the Content Bot topic search.
